settings.header_color.desc: Sets the color of the header depending on the profile color.
settings.close_actions.desc: Adds `Close Others`, `Close to the Right`, `Close Saved`, and `Close All` to the project context menu, opened by right-clicking on a project tab.
settings.easter_egg.desc: Disable the easter egg added by Tweaks & Stuff.
settings.import_all_models.desc: Adds an `Open All` button to the select bedrock model dialog.
settings.pin_tab.desc: Adds `Pin Tab` and `Unpin Tab` to the project context menu, opened by right-clicking on a project tab.
settings.pin_separate_row.desc: Displays pinned tabs in a separate row above all other tabs.
settings.pin_sizing.desc: Controls the size of pinned tabs.
settings.plugin_settings_tag.desc: Adds a tag to each setting showing what plugin its from.
settings.qr_code_session.desc: Generates a QR code to invite friends to collaborate on models.
settings.release_notes.desc: Adds `Show Release Notes` to the help menu.
settings.restore_fullscreen.desc: Controls whether a window should restore to full screen mode if it was existed in full screen.
settings.restore_monitor.desc: Controls whether a window should restore to the last monitor it was closed on.
settings.restore_size.desc: Controls whether a window should restore its size from when it was closed.
settings.share_plugin.desc: Adds a 'Share' button to plugin screen
settings.streamer_mode_spoilers.desc: Adds spoilers to some entries when in streamer mode.
settings.suggest_plugin.desc: Suggests a plugin for unknown model formats.
settings.wrap_tabs.desc: Controls whether tabs should be wrapped over multiple lines when exceeding available space or whether a scrollbar should appear instead.
action.close_others.desc: Close all tabs but this one.
action.close_right.desc: Close all tabs to the right.
